Unsupported URL scheme (gopher) is rejected

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine
from crawlberg import CrawlError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        engine = create_engine(None)
        url = "gopher://invalid.example.com/"
        await scrape(engine, url)
    except CrawlError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
